newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire says half of Island Pl offer sold.
newsitem.headline: Swire says half of Island Pl offer sold.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd said 40 units out of the latest 80 flats on offer at its Island Place residential development in North Point on Hong Kong island were sold on the first day of sale on Wednesday.

The company spokeswoman said the 80 units available for sale included 64 units which were initially put on offer at an average price of HK$8,998 a square foot before the company put on an additional 16 units for sale at HK$9,039 a square foot.
There were 141 potential buyers registered to buy the flats, the spokeswoman said.
The units range in size from 672 to 996 square feet.
